documents.title: Doctor console
documents.text: After doctor login you see the doctor console with counts of your sessions and bookings tied only to your sessions in the Demo database.
questions: how does the doctor dashboard work

documents.title: Doctor sessions
documents.text: My sessions lists your simulated sessions (title, date, time, capacity). Other doctors' sessions are not shown.

documents.title: Doctor appointments
documents.text: Booked appointments lists only bookings on your sessions, with the demo patient name. Patients lists people who booked with you. A doctor cannot open the admin console or another doctor's bookings.
questions: can I see another doctor's appointments

documents.title: Doctor profile
documents.text: Settings opens your profile so you can update name, email, demo phone, and password. No real medical license is shown.
